content: हेतुः [हि-तुन् <ls>Uṇ. 1. 73</ls>] .²1 Cause, reason, object, motive; इति हेतुस्तदुद्भवे <ls>K. P. 1</ls>; <ls>Māl. 1. 23</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 10</ls>; नीचैराख्यं गिरिमधिवसेस्तत्र विश्रामहेतोः <ls>Me. 25</ls>; <ls>Ś. 3. 12</ls>. .²2 Source, origin; स पिता पितरस्तासां केवलं जन्महेतवः <ls>R. 1. 24</ls> ‘authors of their being’. .²3 A means or instrument. .²4 The logical reason, the reason for an inference, middle term (forming the second member of the five-membered syllogism). .²5 Logic, science of reasoning. .²6 Any logical proof or argument. .²7 A rhetorical reason (regarded by some writers as a figure of speech); it is thus defined:-- हेताहतुमता सार्धमभेदो हेतुरुच्यते. .²8 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) The agent of the causal verb; <ls>P. I. 4. 55</ls>. .²9 (with Buddhists) Primary cause. .²10 (with Pāśupatas) The external world and senses (that cause the bondage of the soul). .²11 Mode, manner. .²12 Condition. .²13 Price, cost; दीन्नाराणां दशशती पञ्चाशदधिकाभवत् . धान्यखारीक्रये हेतुर्देशे दुर्भिक्षविक्षते <ls>Rāj. T. 5. 71</ls>. ({%<ab>N. B.</ab>%} The forms हेतुना, हेतोः, rarely हेतौ, are used adverbially in the sense of ‘by reason of’, ‘on account of’, ‘because of’, with <ab>gen.</ab> or in <ab>comp.</ab>; तमसा बहुरूपेण वेष्टिताः कर्महेतुना <ls>Ms. 1. 49</ls>; शास्त्रविज्ञानहेतुना; अल्पस्य हेतोर्बहु हातुमिच्छन् <ls>R. 2. 47</ls>; विस्मृतं कस्य हेतोः <ls>Mu. 1. 1</ls> <ab>&c.</ab>).
